# 2 Baruch Chapter 3 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** The Fall of Jerusalem

---

**3:1** And-I-answered and-said: "O LORD my-Lord, have-I-come-into-the-world for-this [purpose], that-I-might-see the-evils-of-my-mother?

**3:2** Not-so, my-Lord. If-I-have-found-grace in-your-sight, first-take-away my-spirit that-I-may-go-to-my-fathers and-not-see the-destruction-of-my-mother.

**3:3** For two things-press-heavily upon-me, and-I-am-unable to-endure [them]: for-I-cannot-resist the-wrath that has-come-upon-Zion, and-moreover-I-cannot-endure to-see the-evil-of-my-brethren who-have-been-led-into-captivity.

**3:4** But-one-thing I-will-say before-you, O LORD: What-then-will-become-of-your-law? Will-it-also-be-given-over with-Zion into-captivity?

**3:5** Or-shall the-priests who-ministered-before-you be-taken-away? And-shall the-lampstand with-its-light be-extinguished? And-shall the-incense that-is-offered perish?

**3:6** And-shall the-daily-oblations that-were-offered be-discontinued? And-shall the-hymns-of-praise that-were-sung cease?

**3:7** And-where is-all-that which-you-said to-me regarding-this-city? Where-is-it-now?

**3:8** If-you-destroy your-city and-deliver-up your-land to-those-who-hate-us, how-shall the-name-of-Israel-be-remembered?

**3:9** Or-how-shall-we-speak-again of-your-praises? Or-to-whom-shall-your-law-be-explained?"

---

*EMET notes: Baruch's lament raises the question of Torah survival. Hyphenated compounds preserve Syriac construct chains. "Mother" = Jerusalem, a standard personification in Syriac apocalyptic.*
